---
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nf-core/modules/master/modules/environment-schema.json
channels:
  - bioconda
  - conda-forge
dependencies:
  - bioconda::suppa=2.4
  - conda-forge::statsmodels=0.14.6

// Copyright (c) the nf-core community under an open-source MIT license.
// See https://github.com/nf-core/modules for full license, file patching instructions and upstream contributing.

process SUPPA_DIFFSPLICE {
    tag "$meta.id"
    label 'process_high'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container ?
        'https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/d8/d887a6a05dec2a1f64fdff0eac40581f9a1ec30301b2c267bde7f564b0f14270/data' :
        'community.wave.seqera.io/library/suppa:2.4--2612fcca3884f6bc' }"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(events)
    tuple val(meta2), val(condition1), path(expression1), path(psi1)
    tuple val(meta3), val(condition2), path(expression2), path(psi2)
    val method
    val local_area
    val lower_bound_delta_psi
    val is_paired
    val gene_correction
    val multi_testing_correction_alpha
    val save_tpm_events
    val combination_analysis
    val use_median_delta_psi
    val tpm_threshold
    val nan_tpm_threshold

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("*.dpsi"), emit: dpsi
    tuple val(meta), path("*.psivec"), emit: psivec
    tuple val(meta), path("*.tab"), emit: tpm_events, optional: true
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('suppa'), eval("suppa.py -v | sed '1!d;s/.* //'"), topic: versions, emit: versions_suppa
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('statsmodels'), eval("python -c 'import statsmodels; print(statsmodels.__version__)'"), topic: versions, emit: versions_statsmodels

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    def paired_arg = is_paired ? '--paired' : ''
    def area_arg = local_area ? "--area ${local_area}" : ''
    def lower_bound_delta_psi_arg = lower_bound_delta_psi ? "--lower-bound ${lower_bound_delta_psi}" : ''
    def gene_correction_arg = gene_correction ? '--gene-correction' : ''
    def combination_analysis_arg = combination_analysis ? '--combination' : ''
    def alpha_arg = multi_testing_correction_alpha ? "--alpha ${multi_testing_correction_alpha}" : ''
    def save_tpm_events_arg = save_tpm_events ? '--save_tpm_events' : ''
    def median_delta_psi_arg = use_median_delta_psi ? '--median' : ''
    def tpm_threshold_arg = tpm_threshold ? "--tpm-threshold ${tpm_threshold}" : ''
    def nan_tpm_threshold_arg = nan_tpm_threshold ? "--nan-tpm-threshold ${nan_tpm_threshold}" : ''

    [ "empirical", "classical" ].contains(method) ?: error("Invalid method: ${method}. Must be one of 'empirical' or 'classical'.")

    """
    suppa.py \\
        diffSplice \\
        --method ${method} \\
        --psi ${psi1} ${psi2} \\
        --tpm ${expression1} ${expression2} \\
        --input ${events} \\
        --output ${prefix} \\
        ${area_arg} \\
        ${lower_bound_delta_psi_arg} \\
        ${paired_arg} \\
        ${gene_correction_arg} \\
        ${combination_analysis_arg} \\
        ${alpha_arg} \\
        ${save_tpm_events_arg} \\
        ${median_delta_psi_arg} \\
        ${tpm_threshold_arg} \\
        ${nan_tpm_threshold_arg} \\
        $args
    """

    stub:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    echo $args

    touch ${prefix}.dpsi
    touch ${prefix}.psivec
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/suppa/diffsplice"
description: "Perform differential splicing analysis using SUPPA."
keywords:
- "alternative splicing"
- "differential splicing"
- "suppa"
- "genomics"
tools:
- suppa:
    description: "Fast, accurate, and uncertainty-aware differential splicing analysis\
      \ across multiple conditions."
    homepage: "https://github.com/comprna/SUPPA"
    documentation: "https://github.com/comprna/SUPPA"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/comprna/SUPPA"
    doi: "10.1186/s13059-018-1417-1"
    licence:
    - "MIT"
    identifier: "biotools:suppa"
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing genome information\ne.g. `[ id:'genome1'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - events:
      type: "file"
      description: "Splicing events file (events per event or transcript)"
      pattern: "*.{ioe,ioi}"
      ontologies: []
- - meta2:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing samples information from condition 1\ne.g.\
        \ `[ id:'samples1' ]`\n"
  - condition1:
      type: "string"
      description: "Condition 1 name"
      pattern: "*"
      ontologies: []
  - expression1:
      type: "file"
      description: "Expression file for condition 1 (in TPM units)"
      pattern: "*.txt"
      ontologies: []
  - psi1:
      type: "file"
      description: "PSI file for condition 1"
      pattern: "*.psi"
      ontologies: []
- - meta3:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing samples information from condition 2\ne.g.\
        \ `[ id:'samples2' ]`\n"
  - condition2:
      type: "string"
      description: "Condition 2 name"
      pattern: "*"
      ontologies: []
  - expression2:
      type: "file"
      description: "Expression file for condition 2 (in TPM units)"
      pattern: "*.txt"
      ontologies: []
  - psi2:
      type: "file"
      description: "PSI file for condition 2"
      pattern: "*.psi"
      ontologies: []
- method:
    type: "string"
    description: "Method to use for differential splicing analysis. Options are \"\
      empirical\" or \"classical\"."
- local_area:
    type: "integer"
    description: "Number of points in the local area of the delta PSI - average TPM\
      \ distribution."
    default: 1000
- lower_bound_delta_psi:
    type: "float"
    description: "Lower bound for the absolute delta PSI to test for significant.\
      \ Events with less than this delta PSI will not be tested. Only valid for the\
      \ \"empirical\" method."
    default: 0
- is_paired:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Indicates if replicates across conditions are paired."
    default: false
- gene_correction:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Correction of the p-values by gene."
    default: false
- multi_testing_correction_alpha:
    type: "float"
    description: "Family-wise error rate to use for the multiple testing correction."
    default: 0.05
- save_tpm_events:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "The average log TPM of the events will be saved in an external file."
    default: false
- combination_analysis:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "SUPPA will perform the analysis between all possible combinations\
      \ of conditions."
    default: false
- use_median_delta_psi:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "SUPPA will use the median delta PSI, instead of the mean."
    default: false
- tpm_threshold:
    type: "float"
    description: "Minimum expression (calculated as average TPM value within-replicates\
      \ and between-conditions) to be included in the analysis."
    default: 0
- nan_tpm_threshold:
    type: "float"
    description: "Proportion of samples with nan values allowed per condition to calculate\
      \ a delta PSI."
    default: 0
output:
  dpsi:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing genome information\ne.g. `[ id:'genome1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.dpsi':
        type: "file"
        description: "Differential splicing analysis results file"
        pattern: "*.dpsi"
        ontologies: []
  psivec:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing genome information\ne.g. `[ id:'genome1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.psivec':
        type: "file"
        description: "PSI values for all events in the analysis"
        pattern: "*.psivec"
        ontologies: []
  tpm_events:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing genome information\ne.g. `[ id:'genome1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.tab':
        type: "file"
        description: "Average log TPM of the events"
        pattern: "*.tab"
        ontologies: []
  versions_suppa:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - suppa:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - suppa.py -v | sed '1!d;s/.* //':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
  versions_statsmodels:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - statsmodels:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - python -c 'import statsmodels; print(statsmodels.__version__)':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - suppa:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - suppa.py -v | sed '1!d;s/.* //':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - statsmodels:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - python -c 'import statsmodels; print(statsmodels.__version__)':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
authors:
- "@lathikaa"
- "@piplus2"
maintainers:
- "@piplus2"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
license: "MIT License"
